page.overview:
What is Dusk Stone?

A is an item introduced in Generation IV.

The Dusk Stone is a purplish-black, irregularly-shaped Evolutionary Stone with a dark center. It evolves the following Pokémon:

The Dusk Stone is also an item in the Pokémon Mystery Dungeon series and functions identically as in the Pokémon core series.
